A copy is saved at J:\Mark-LV\.manus\worktrees\oqxsjapnukgvkjfet4wgip\manus-slides\jarvis-0-4-0-next-workflow-mux9yp94-a9e26abd/design.md — do not read it again, and do not treat it as a slide file.

<design_brief>
## Design Concept
This deck serves as an upward-facing technical executive briefing, merging the strict, objective information design of the Swiss International Style with the atmospheric depth of a cinematic tech aesthetic. We borrow the rigorous grid discipline and whitespace-first layout from Swiss design, while adopting the midnight-navy and teal/amber palette of high-end cinematic UI to project a sense of advanced engineering. The color story is predominantly cool and deep: a near-black midnight navy background grounds the presentation, creating stark contrast for crisp white headings and slate body text. The tech cliche of generic neon blue gradients is strictly avoided; instead, we use flat, precisely applied teal for current architecture and restrained amber to flag proposed or unknown elements. The typographic voice is highly technical and precise, utilizing a modern, engineered sans-serif for Thai readability alongside a monospaced typeface for English API terminology. 

## Visual Language
- **Imagery:** Hero-driven abstract AI voice-assistant illustration on the cover only. Content pages are strictly text, HTML/CSS diagrams, and tables (no decorative photography).
- **Containers:** Whitespace-first. No card grids. Use thin, structural 1px lines (`#334155`) to define architectural boundaries and separate diagram components.
- **Icons:** Sharp, minimal outline icons used strictly for system capabilities (camera, mic, location) and architectural nodes; no purely decorative icons.
- **Dataviz:** Status-driven tables with clean row borders (`#1E293B`) and no vertical lines. System diagrams utilize bordered text boxes and straight orthogonal connector lines. Chart series (if needed) use teal (`#14B8A6`) for verified data and amber (`#F59E0B`) for projected/untested data.
- **Motif:** A rigid top-right technical label system. Every content slide carries a monospaced tracking code (e.g., `J-0.4 // [CURRENT]`, `J-NEXT // [PROPOSED]`, or `[UNKNOWN]`) color-coded to the primary action of the slide, anchoring the top-right corner.

## Layout Directives
- **Global:** 60px margins. Left-aligned typography. The technical motif sits at the top-right. Page numbers at bottom-right in monospace. All English API/module terms must be wrapped in a monospaced font.
- **Cover:** Cinematic AI abstract illustration positioned right/center, with a massive left-aligned title, brief summary, and a distinct starting motif.
- **Table of Contents:** Excluded from outline; if needed, use a structural numbered list with thin dividing lines.
- **Section Dividers:** High-contrast layout with a giant section number (e.g., 01, 02) overlapping a horizontal rule, plus a sharp verdict heading.
- **Closing:** Revisit the cover's ambient background, featuring a single, large amber PROPOSED label and the primary strategic question.
- **Slide Map:**

| id | pattern | image | density |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| cover | Hero split with giant title and abstract AI art | hero | low |
| evidence | Status table defining verified vs untested items | none | medium |
| assistant | Node diagram showing multi-provider connections | none | medium |
| capabilities | Two-column capability list with system icons | none | medium |
| memory | Relationship flow diagram (History/Providers) | none | high |
| workflow_current | Code-block styled text with structural analysis | none | medium |
| architecture | Large horizontal system architecture diagram | none | high |
| run_lifecycle | Linear timeline/process flow diagram | none | high |
| roadmap | Milestone timeline with status markers | none | medium |
| decisions | Bulleted checklist with amber warning highlights | none | medium |

## Design Tokens

| token | hex | usage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| bg-midnight | `#0B1120` | Page background |
| text-heading | `#FFFFFF` | Slide titles, key metrics, and primary diagram nodes |
| text-body | `#94A3B8` | Standard body text, secondary labels |
| border-rule | `#334155` | Architectural container lines, diagram connectors |
| bg-block | `#0F172A` | Background for code blocks or highlighted diagram nodes |
| status-current | `#14B8A6` | Accent for verified features, CURRENT labels, teal highlights |
| status-proposed | `#F59E0B` | Accent for roadmap, PROPOSED labels, amber highlights |
| status-unknown | `#EF4444` | Accent for UNKNOWN constraints or missing semantics |

| role | family | size (px) | applies_to |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| display | IBM Plex Sans Thai | 48 | Cover title, section numbers |
| heading | IBM Plex Sans Thai | 32 | Content page titles, section verdicts |
| body | IBM Plex Sans Thai | 18 | Standard paragraph text, lists, table cells |
| mono | IBM Plex Mono | 16 | API terms, workflow functions, status tags, motif |
| caption | IBM Plex Sans Thai | 14 | Diagram labels, footnote disclaimers |

## Guardrails
- **Forbidden:** No card-grid layouts on content slides (enforce whitespace and line separators).
- **Forbidden:** No claims of tested APK runtime behavior (use the UNKNOWN or PROPOSED tags).
- **Forbidden:** No glowing gradients or drop shadows (cinematic feel comes from color contrast, not layer effects).
- **Forbidden:** No centered text alignments for lists or paragraphs (strict left-alignment required).
- **Size floors:** Body ≥18px, Caption ≥14px, Monospace API terms ≥16px.
</design_brief>
